limitations: This five-case reviewer-owned set is bound to the approved local Charter Nuclei template result for the recorded reviewer version; it is not a claim of broad vulnerability coverage.
A change to the reviewed Charter template, normalized finding identity, or allowed request outcome requires a new reviewed cases/gold version before it can be used for acceptance.
improvement_proposals: Expand the reviewer-owned set only after adding independently reviewed findings and benign controls from a new scoped Charter template review.
Add a receipt-specific case only if its expectations can remain response-free and bind to the immutable request contract.
